story.problem: A customer slammed us for slow service. How do I reply without sounding defensive?
story.promise: Tell me your problem. I'll tell you what to do.
story.nextMove: Next move: Reply today before the dinner rush.

scenes.name: Hook
scenes.onScreenText: A bad review just hit. What do you say?
scenes.action: Headline hits, then smash-cut to the chat composer already in frame. Restaurant chip is already locked — do not play the industry picker.
scenes.animationNotes: Two seconds only. No logo hold. Cut into chat on the word review.

scenes.name: Owner types the problem
scenes.onScreenText: A customer slammed us for slow service. How do I reply without sounding defensive?
scenes.voiceover: Type it. Get the next move.
scenes.action: Question types into What's going on with your business? Gold send button lights and taps.
scenes.animationNotes: Faster than real typing. Shorten the question on screen if it wraps too much. Cut on send.

scenes.name: Steady reply
scenes.onScreenText: Reply within 24 hours. Acknowledge the wait. Offer a private follow-up.
scenes.action: Brief Steady is thinking flash, then the answer streams in. Do not wait on thinking.
scenes.animationNotes: Thinking is a blink, not a beat. Stream 2 short lines of the script only.

scenes.name: Next move
scenes.onScreenText: Next move: Reply today before the dinner rush.
scenes.action: Freeze and punch in on the Next move line in gold. This is the lock-in of the 10-second cut.
scenes.animationNotes: Hold 1.5 seconds. No extra UI motion. Captions stay on.

scenes.name: End card
scenes.action: Wordmark, Your business co-pilot, CTA. Hold until 0:10.
scenes.animationNotes: Last frame is the promise, not pricing. Destination: register or chat.
